title: Solstitium public evidence: daily climate-forecast record and OpenTimestamps seals
description: Public evidence slice of Solstitium's daily climate-prediction record: the verification ledger of forecast-outcome pairs, a model bakeoff for a Brazil frost case, two index term sheets, and a chain of daily OpenTimestamps-sealed manifests. The repository documents exactly what a third party can and cannot check (VERIFY.md) and regenerates every published number from the record.
